gloss: to be buried, to be filled

definitions.gloss: to be buried, to be covered
to be filled, to be packed

examples.japanese: {予定|よてい}が{埋|う}まっている。

notes:
{埋|う}まる is an intransitive godan verb meaning to be buried or filled.

TRANSITIVITY PAIR:
- {埋|う}まる ({自動詞|じどうし}): to be buried/filled
- {埋|う}める ({他動詞|たどうし}): to bury/fill

PHYSICAL BURIAL:
- {雪|ゆき}に{埋|う}まる: to be buried in snow
- {砂|すな}に{埋|う}まる: to be buried in sand
- {落|お}ち{葉|ば}に{埋|う}まる: to be covered in fallen leaves

FIGURATIVE (filled up):
- {席|せき}が{埋|う}まる: seats fill up
- {予定|よてい}が{埋|う}まる: schedule fills up
- {空白|くうはく}が{埋|う}まる: gaps get filled
- {穴|あな}が{埋|う}まる: holes get filled

RELATED:
- {埋|う}め{立|た}てる: to reclaim land (by filling)
- {埋|まい}{蔵|ぞう}: buried (treasure, resources)
